notes:
Site: milton.in (Shopify, HTTP 200 direct, no WAF, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow). Company storefront sells sibling brands Milton, Treo, ProCook, Spotzero, Milton Appliances and a sub-line 'Milton Concepts' (all on the same domain/company per prior Home-Decor pass identity check). Nav discovery: header mega-menu has a 'Best Sellers' tab (data-parent="best-sellers") whose own sub-buttons are data-collection="bestsellers" (sitewide, labelled 'Bestsellers'), "milton-bestsellers", and "procook-bestsellers" - confirming genuine site-exposed brand children under Bestsellers. Brand landing pages /pages/treo and /pages/spotzero additionally link their own bestseller collections (treo-bestsellers-1, spotzero-bestsellers) even though those aren't in the condensed header dropdown. /pages/milton-concepts (linked from the homepage header logo) links to /collections/popular-choices-milton-concpets, titled 'Popular Choices (Milton Concepts)' - a genuine 'Most Popular'-type PLP for that sub-line, so included as a Bestsellers-family row. Sitemap also listed /collections/treo-bestsellers (no -1 suffix): confirmed via /products.json that this handle now returns 0 products (stale/superseded duplicate of treo-bestsellers-1, which the live /pages/treo page actually links and which has 4 products) - dropped per zero-product rule. All qty values are the rendered

text and were independently cross-checked by paginating each collection's /products.json (limit=250) and counting distinct product ids - all matched exactly, no Shopify products_count/tc field used. Checked and rejected as non-Bestsellers: 'popular-choices-milton-concpets' was the only 'Popular'-labelled candidate found; no other Bestsellers-adjacent handles existed in the collections sitemap beyond those listed here. No Hindi/regional-language content encountered anywhere; all labels are native English.
